40018919.author: पदार्थः
40018919.content: अथ and तदा then, मातलिः Matali, राघवम् to Raghava, संस्मारयामास reminded, वीर hero, अजानन्निव as if you don't know, त्वम् you, एनम् in that way, किम् why, अनुवर्तसे are you doing

40018919.author: Translation
40018919.content: Matali reminded Rama in this way," O heroic Rama, why are you doing this way, as if you do not know?"

40018920.author: पदार्थः
40018920.content: प्रभो king, त्वम् you, वधाय destruction, अस्मै you, पैतामहम् creator Brahma, अस्त्रम् missile, विसृज use, सुरैः Suras, यः they, विनाशकालः for the destruction, कथितः spoken, सः he, अद्य now, वर्तते use

40018920.author: Translation
40018920.content: "O king! As spoken by Suras, the destruction of Ravana has come now. Use the missile of the creator Brahma."

40018921.author: पदार्थः
40018921.content: ततः then, मातलेः by Matali, तेनवाक्येन by that suggestion, संस्मारितः reminded of, वीर्यवान् valiant, रामः Rama, ब्रह्मदत्तम् bestowed by Brahma, युधि in war, अमोघम् wonderful, यम् that which, महाबाणम् great arrow, प्रथमम् first, भगवान् divine, अगस्त्यः by Agastya, ऋषिःsage, तस्मै that, पादात्, दीप्तम् glowing, निःश्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, उरगम् इव like serpent, शरम् shaft, जग्राह seized hold of

40018921.author: Translation
40018921.content: Suggested and reminded by Matali, valiant Sri Rama seized hold of the wonderful glowing arrow, bestowed by Brahma, and given by the divine to sage Agastya first. Breathing heavily, like a serpent, Rama seized the arrow.

40018922.author: पदार्थः
40018922.content: ततः then, मातलेः by Matali, तेनवाक्येन by that suggestion, संस्मारितः reminded of, वीर्यवान् valiant, रामः Rama, ब्रह्मदत्तम् bestowed by Brahma, युधि in war, अमोघम् wonderful, यम् that which, महाबाणम् great arrow, प्रथमम् first, भगवान् divine, अगस्त्यः by Agastya, ऋषिःsage, तस्मै that, पादात्, दीप्तम् glowing, निःश्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, उरगम् इव like serpent, शरम् shaft, जग्राह seized hold of

40018922.author: Translation
40018922.content: Suggested and reminded by Matali, valiant Sri Rama seized hold of the wonderful glowing arrow, bestowed by Brahma, and given by the divine to sage Agastya first. Breathing heavily, like a serpent, Rama seized the arrow.

40018923.author: पदार्थः
40018923.content: पूर्वम् earlier, इन्द्रार्थम् for Indra's sake, अमितेजसा very powerful, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, निर्मितम् for the sake, पूर्वम् earlier, त्रिलोकजयकाङ्क्षिणः desirous to gain the three worlds, सुरपतेः king of gods, दत्तम् bestowed

40018923.author: Translation
40018923.content: Earlier, this powerful arrow was created for Indra's sake by Brahma and was bestowed to Indra, the king of gods, who was desirous of conquering the three worlds.

40018924.author: पदार्थः
40018924.content: यस्य its, वाजेषु feathers, पवनः presided by wind god, फले head, पावकभास्करौ presided by fire and Sun god, गौरवे energy, मेरुमन्दरौ Meru and Mandara presided over, शरीरम् body, आकाशमयम् like sky

40018924.author: Translation
40018924.content: The wind god presided over its feathers, the fire god and the Sun god presided over its head, its energy was presided over by Meru and Mandara mountains and its weight by the sky.

40018925.author: पदार्थः
40018925.content: वपुषा form, जाज्वल्यमानम् shining, सुपुङ्खम् the feathers, हेमभूषितम्decked with gold, सर्वभूतानाम् all beings, तेजसा splendid, कृतम् crafted, भास्करवर्चसम् like the Sun in brilliance

40018925.author: Translation
40018925.content: Its form was shining with feathers, decked with gold, splendid with all elements and brilliant like the sun.

40018926.author: पदार्थः
40018926.content: सधूमम् its fire, कालानगिम् इव like the universal dissolution, दीप्तम् burning, अशीविषोपमम् like the venomous serpent, नरनागरश्ववृद्धानाम् hosts of men, elephants, horses of enemies, भेदनम् splitting, क्षिप्रकारिणम् quick in action

40018926.author: Translation
40018926.content: Like fire at the time of dissolution of the universe, burning like venomous serpent, capable of splitting hosts of enemy, men, elephants, and horses and quick in action.

40018927.author: पदार्थः
40018927.content: द्वाराणाम् gateways, परिघाणाम् iron bars, गिरीणांचापि even mountains, भेदनम् splitting, नानारुधिरदिग्धाङ्गम् smeared with blood of various Asuras, मेदोदिग्धम् marrow of the brain, सुदारुणम् of dreadful appearance

40018927.author: Translation
40018927.content: Capable of splitting gateways, iron bars, even mountains, smeared with blood and brain marrow of various Asuras, of dreadful appearance.

40018928.author: पदार्थः
40018928.content: वज्रसारम् strong as thunderbolt, महानादम् loud sounding, नानासमितिदारणम् dispersing every deceitful kind of army, सर्ववित्रासनम् frightening all kinds of beings, श्वसन्तम् hissing, पन्नगम् serpent, इव like

40018928.author: Translation
40018928.content: Strong as thunderbolt, loud sounding, dispersing every deceitful kind of army, frightening to all kinds of beings, hissing like a serpent.

40018929.author: पदार्थः
40018929.content: युद्धे in war, कङ्कगृध्राबकानां च buzzards, vultures, herons कोमायुगणरक्षसाम् jackals and Rakshasas, नित्यम् always, भक्षप्रदम् provider of food, यमरूपम् form of Yama, भयावहम् causing terror

40018929.author: Translation
40018929.content: In war, it provides food for buzzards, vultures, and herons, and also jackals and Rakshasas, causing terror in the form of Yama (God of death).

40018930.author: पदार्थः
40018930.content: वानरेन्द्राणाम् for Vanara chiefs, नन्दनम् delight, रक्षसाम् for Rakshasas, अवसादनम् causes destruction, गरुत्मतः for eagles, चित्रैः picturesque, विविधैः several, वाजैः for arrows, वाजितम् plumes

40018930.author: Translation
40018930.content: Provides delight for Vanara chiefs, causes destruction of Rakshasas, provides picturesque plumes of eagles to arrows.

40018931.author: पदार्थः
40018931.content: महाबलः mighty, बली strong, रामः Rama, लोकानाम् of the world, उत्तमेषुम् great arrow, इक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम् dispellar of fear for Ikshvaku, द्विषताम् of enemies, कीर्तिहरणम् takes away the glory, आत्मनः own, प्रहर्षणम् delighting, तम् that, महेषुम् great arrow, वेदप्रोक्तेन chanting vedas, विधिना as tradition, अभिम्नत्यर charging with mystic power, कार्मुके bow, सन्दधे fitted

40018931.author: Translation
40018931.content: The great arrow, was a dispeller of fear of enemies to Ikshvaku kings, which takes away the glory of enemies, delighting to oneself, chanting vedas as per tradition, charging with mystic power, mighty strong Rama fitted to the bow.

40018932.author: पदार्थः
40018932.content: महाबलः mighty, बली strong, रामः Rama, लोकानाम् of the world, उत्तमेषुम् great arrow, इक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम् dispellar of fear for Ikshvaku, द्विषताम् of enemies, कीर्तिहरणम् takes away the glory, आत्मनः own, प्रहर्षणम् delighting, तम् that, महेषुम् great arrow, वेदप्रोक्तेन chanting vedas, विधिना as tradition, अभिम्नत्यर charging with mystic power, कार्मुके bow, सन्दधे fitted

40018932.author: Translation
40018932.content: The great arrow, was a dispeller of fear of enemies to Ikshvaku kings, which takes away the glory of enemies, delighting to oneself, chanting vedas as per tradition, charging with mystic power, mighty strong Rama fitted to the bow.

40018933.author: पदार्थः
40018933.content: राघवेण by Raghava, तस्मिन् his own, शरोत्तमे excellent arrow, सधनीयमाने started fixing, सर्वभूतानि all beings, सन्त्रेषु terrified, वसुन्धरा earth, चचाल shook

40018933.author: Translation
40018933.content: As Raghava started fixing his excellent arrow, all beings got terrified and the earth shook.

40018934.author: पदार्थः
40018934.content: सङ्क्रुद्धः very furious, सः he, कार्मुकम् bow, भृशम् fully, आयम्य stretched, परमायत्तः very well prepared, मर्मविदारणम् capable of tearing into vital parts, शरम् arrow, रावणाय on Ravana, चिक्षेप released

40018934.author: Translation
40018934.content: Rama, provoked by anger, stretched the bow to full length, very well prepared, released the arrow on Ravana, which was capable of tearing into the vital parts.

40018935.author: पदार्थः
40018935.content: वज्रिबाहुविसर्जितः released from thunderbolt hurled by the arm of Indra, वज्रःइव like thunderbolt, दुर्धर्षः difficult, कृतान्तःइव capable of bringing to an end, अवार्यः prevent, सः that, रावणोरसि into Ravana's chest, न्यपतत् penetrated

40018935.author: Translation
40018935.content: Like the thunderbolt hurled by the arm of Indra, difficult to obstruct, capable of bringing life to an end, that arrow released by Rama penetrated into Ravana's chest.

40018936.author: पदार्थः
40018936.content: विसृष्टः loosed, महावेगः high velocity शरीरान्तकरः putting an end to the body, सःशरः that arrow, दुरात्मनः evil minded, तस्य his, रावणस्य Ravana's, हृदयम् heart, बिभेद split as under

40018936.author: Translation
40018936.content: Loosed at high velocity, that arrow capable of putting an end to the body, split as under the heart of evilminded Ravana

40018937.author: पदार्थः
40018937.content: शरीरान्तकरः capable of putting an end to the body, सःशरः that arrow, वेगेन speedily, रावणस्य Ravana's, प्राणान् life, हरन् took out, रुधिराक्तः smeared with blood, धरणीतलम् into the ground, विवेश entered

40018937.author: Translation
40018937.content: That arrow which was capable of putting an end to the body took out Ravana's life and smeared with blood, it entered the earth.

40018938.author: पदार्थः
40018938.content: सःशरः that arrow, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा on killing, रुधिरार्द्रीकृतच्छविः soaked in blood, कृतकर्मा having accomplished the task, निभृतवत् quietly, स्वतूणीम् its quiver, पुनः again, अविशत् reentered

40018938.author: Translation
40018938.content: That arrow of Rama, on killing Ravana, soaked in blood, having accomplished the task quietly reentered its quiver.

40018939.author: पदार्थः
40018939.content: हतस्य killed, जीवितात् life, भ्रश्यमानस्य fallen from, तस्य his, हस्तात् hand, ससायकम् arrow, कार्मुकम् bow, आशु with, प्राणैःसह with life breath, निपपात fell

40018939.author: Translation
40018939.content: Thus, when Ravana was killed and lost his life, the bow and arrow in his hand also fell along with his life breath.

40018940.author: पदार्थः
40018940.content: भीमवेगः terrific speed, महाद्युतिः courageous, नैरृतेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas, गतासुः having gone, वज्रहतः killed by thunderbolt, वृत्रःयथा Vrttra, स्यन्दनात् when struck down, भूमौ on earth, पपात fell

40018940.author: Translation
40018940.content: The king of Rakshasas, who possessed terrific speed and courage, having lost life, fell on earth like Vrttra struck down by thunderbolt.

40018941.author: पदार्थः
40018941.content: भूमौ on earth surface, पतितम् fallen, तम् that, दृष्टवा seeing, हतशेषाः left after killing, निशाचराः night rangers, हतनाथाः Lord killed, भयत्रस्ताः fearing, सर्वतः all over, सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः ran

40018941.author: Translation
40018941.content: Seeing their Lord killed and fallen on the ground, the leftover night rangers fled all over in fear.

40018942.author: पदार्थः
40018942.content: द्रुमयोधिनः holding trees, वानराः Vanaras, तान् they, सर्वतःall sides, अभिपेतुः roaming, दशग्रीववधम् killed ten headed Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, वानराः Vanaras, जितकाशिनः triumphant

40018942.author: Translation
40018942.content: Seeing Ravana killed, the Vanaras holding trees went roaming on all sides, feeling triumphant.

40018943.author: पदार्थः
40018943.content: वानरैः by Vanaras, अर्दिताः hurt, भ्रष्टाः lost battle, भयात् out of fear, हताश्रयत्वात् their king being killed, करुणैः piteous, बाष्पप्रस्रवणैः eyes filled with tears, मुखैः face, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभ्यपतन् went towards

40018943.author: Translation
40018943.content: The Rakshasas hurt by the Vanaras, lost battle and their king killed, were piteous and went towards Lanka in fear, eyes filled with tears.

40018944.author: पदार्थः
40018944.content: ततः then, जितकाशिनः feeling triumphant, वानराः Vanaras, सम्हृष्टाः highly delighted, राघवजयम् Rama's victory, रावणस्य Ravana's, तद्वधं च death of Ravana, वदन्तः shouted, विनेदुः in joy

40018944.author: Translation
40018944.content: Then the Vanaras, feeling triumphant, got highly excited over Rama's victory and the death of Ravana, and shouted aloud in joy.

40018945.author: पदार्थः
40018945.content: अथ and now, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, सौम्याः gods, त्रिदशदुन्धुभिः thirty drums, व्यनदत् sounded, तत्र there, दिव्यगन्धवहः divine fragrance, सुसुखः pleasant, मारुतः breeze, ववौ blew

40018945.author: Translation
40018945.content: And then thirty drums of gods sounded in the sky. Divine fragrant pleasant breeze blew.

40018946.author: पदार्थः
40018946.content: तदा then, अन्तरिक्षात् from the heaven, राघवरथम् on Raghava's chariot, किरन्ती covering, दुरवापा difficult to find out, मनोहरा very pleasing, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, भुवि on earth, निपपात fell

40018946.author: Translation
40018946.content: Then from heaven, a very pleasing shower of flowers, difficult to know from where, fell on Raghava's chariot covering it and dropped on the ground.

40018947.author: पदार्थः
40018947.content: महात्मनाम् great soul, देवतानाम् gods too, साधुसाधुइति well done well done, राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता praised Rama, अग्य्रा the foremost, वाक् words, गगने in the heaven, विशुश्रुवे च heard

40018947.author: Translation
40018947.content: The gods too praised Sri Rama, the great soul saying, 'Well done, Well done', from the heaven, which was distinctly heard.

40018948.author: पदार्थः
40018948.content: रौद्रे terror, सर्वलोकभयङ्करे of all worlds, रावणे Ravana, निहते killed, चारणैः Charanas, देवानाम् Devas, महान् great, हर्षः joy, अविवेश filled

40018948.author: Translation
40018948.content: When Ravana, a terror of all worlds was killed, the Charanas and Devas were filled with great joy.

40018949.author: पदार्थः
40018949.content: राघवः Raghava, राक्षसपुङ्गवम् foremost of the Rakshasas, हत्वा killed, प्रीतः pleased, राघवः Raghava, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अङ्गदं च and Angada, विभीषणं च Vibheeshana also, सकामम् their desire fulfilled, चकार made them happy

40018949.author: Translation
40018949.content: The foremost of the Rakshasas killed, Raghava was pleased and having fulfilled the desire of Sugriva, Angada, Vibheeshana, he made them happy.

40018950.author: पदार्थः
40018950.content: ततः then, मरुद्गणाः hosts of gods, प्रशमम् tranquil, प्रजग्मुः attained, दिशः quarters, प्रसेदुः brightened, नभः sky, विमलम् clear, अभवत् became, मही earth, न चकम्पे no longer shook, मारुतः wind, ववौ blew, दिवाकरःचापि even the Sun, स्थिरप्रभः steady radiance, अभवत् became

40018950.author: Translation
40018950.content: Then the host of gods attained tranquil, quarters brightened, sky became clear, earth no longer shook, wind blew and even the Sun became steady and radiant.

40018951.author: पदार्थः
40018951.content: ततः then, सुहृद्विशिष्टाः coming together, सहलक्ष्मणाः accompanied by Lakshmana, सुग्रीवविभीषणाङ्गदाः Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada, रणे in the battle, विजयेन by the victory, हृष्टाः happy, अभिरामम् charming, रामम् Rama, समेत्य friends together, तदा then, विधिना as tradition goes, अभ्यपूजयन् offered prayers

40018951.author: Translation
40018951.content: Then all of them (hosts of gods) coming together, accompanied by Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada along with other friends, happy about the victory in the battle offered prayers to charming Sri Rama in accordance with tradition.
